Chapter 1053: 9 Spirit Might King (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2

Chapter 1053: Chapter 9 Spirit Might King (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2

On the surface, Marquis Purple Dream expended a portion of his true body’s origin source to hold off Lord Qingfen, while unleashing hundreds of peak dominator-level puppets to throw Qingfen City into chaos.

In secret, he commanded his disciples to wield the Myriad Formation Crystal to replicate the city’s numerous grand formations.

Afterward, even if Lord Qingfen sensed something amiss, it would be too late. As long as the replicated Heart of Myriad Formation that mirrored the city’s defenses fell into Marquis Purple Dream’s hands, the defensive formations of Qingfen City would be rendered useless.

The consequences of such an outcome were unimaginable.

Marquis Purple Dream would only need to gather several Great Lords to easily breach Qingfen City, and at that point, the entire Qingfen Domain would be doomed.

“I suppose I was just lucky,” Lin Yuan said.

Upon seeing the Myriad Formation Crystal in the hands of the purple-haired woman, Lin Yuan gained a rough understanding of their plan.

“Fortunately, you were here,”

Lord Qingfen said, his tone laced with relief. If not for Lin Yuan, the purple-haired woman and her group might have left Qingfen City smoothly with the Myriad Formation Crystal.

If that had happened, how could he be sitting here so peacefully now?

Then again, Lord Qingfen wasn’t entirely sure about Marquis Purple Dream’s real scheme. Even with some suspicions, he couldn’t ascertain it.

“This time, that Purple Dream has suffered a significant loss. I suspect this Myriad Formation Crystal was granted by the higher-ups of the Ancient Country.”

“She’s bound to face severe punishment for losing it.”

“No wonder her face turned pale when I escaped the dream she had woven,”

Lord Qingfen said with a smirk on his face.

In hindsight, Marquis Purple Dream had indeed lost both her troops and the figurative bride in this failed operation.

“How valuable is this Myriad Formation Crystal, exactly?” Lin Yuan asked as he stroked the crystal stone in his hand.

Though the crystal carried immense strategic significance for large-scale forces, it held little personal meaning for Lin Yuan.

As for the essence of the grand formations contained inside? Lin Yuan had already comprehended it over the time he’d held the crystal.

Simply put, Lin Yuan had fully grasped the essence of this Myriad Formation Crystal and could replicate the formations within at will; he himself could now be considered the equivalent of a Myriad Formation Crystal.

“You intend to… sell this Myriad Formation Crystal?” Lord Qingfen asked, slightly surprised while looking at Lin Yuan.

“Yes,”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Currently, the resources needed for his cultivation and advancement were massive, and relying solely on Lord Qingfen for support felt a bit unreasonable. Besides, Lord Qingfen wouldn’t be able to sustain it for very long.

While the Fierce Sun Divine Body possessed the ability to burn and devour external items as cultivation resources, the repercussions of excessive reliance on this ability were monumental. Occasional use might not cause significant problems, but making it a consistent practice could draw the attention of truly powerful figures from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

“The Myriad Formation Crystal has substantial value and will be easy to sell.”

Lord Qingfen contemplated for a moment before saying, “Leave this matter to me. I’ll contact buyers who have a genuine need for the Myriad Formation Crystal.”

As a renowned peak-level Great Lord, Lord Qingfen naturally had many connections.

With Lord Qingfen handling the negotiations, the crystal could be sold at the highest possible price. If Lin Yuan were to sell it on his own, he’d risk falling into traps.

…

After finalizing the details for selling the Myriad Formation Crystal,

Lin Yuan and Lord Qingfen shifted their discussion to the Purple Dream Domain.

“Marquis Purple Dream is unlikely to let this go,” Lin Yuan said.

From the strategies to stall Lord Qingfen to the attempt to replicate Qingfen City’s grand formations using the Myriad Formation Crystal, each step revealed Marquis Purple Dream’s unrelenting ambition for Qingfen City and the Qingfen Domain.

Would Purple Dream Marquis truly retreat after such a failure?

Furthermore, the assault on Qingfen City might not solely be Marquis Purple Dream’s initiative. The Myriad Formation Crystal was likely bestowed by the higher-ups of their Ancient Country, and the true mastermind behind the move on Qingfen City could be one of those high-ranking figures.

“I am well aware,”

Lord Qingfen nodded. With his strategic thinking, he had naturally deduced several possibilities.

“I’ll take my leave now; a few of my friends have already expressed considerable interest in the Myriad Formation Crystal.”

Lord Qingfen stood up and departed.

…

Lord Qingfen disappeared.

The Sky Burning Court fell silent once more.

“Purple Dream Domain…” Lin Yuan’s thoughts wandered before he stopped ruminating further.

Considering Lord Qingfen’s knowledge of the Purple Dream Domain and its affiliated Ancient Country, Lin Yuan trusted him to handle the situation appropriately. As for the next steps against the Purple Dream Domain, Lord Qingfen would provide guidance.

Lin Yuan’s priority was to continue cultivating and strengthening himself.

No matter the circumstances or location, enhancing one’s strength was always the correct course of action. The philosophy of strength reigning supreme was universal across any realm or world.

“The number of Fiery Sun Seeds I’ve condensed now exceeds 31,000, yet continuing to condense more is growing increasingly difficult.”

Lin Yuan silently contemplated.

In truth, after reaching 30,000 Fiery Sun Seeds, the difficulty in condensing each additional seed had increased by tens of times. Upon reaching 31,000 seeds, it had surged by another order of magnitude.

“At my current pace, it will likely take six to seven hundred years to condense 33,333 Fiery Sun Seeds,”

Lin Yuan estimated inwardly.

This calculation assumed that each subsequent Fiery Sun Seed would be significantly harder to condense than the last.

“It seems I’m still far behind those core royalty of the Ancient Countries.”

Lin Yuan increasingly felt the arduous challenges of cultivation—particularly in regards to condensing Fiery Sun Seeds. He couldn’t help but envy those core royal bloodlines who could effortlessly condense Fiery Sun Seeds even while asleep.

What Lin Yuan didn’t know was that even the core royal bloodlines with the purest of Fierce Sun Ancient Country lineage found the process of condensing Fiery Sun Seeds far from easy. Especially beyond 20,000 seeds, their efforts were similarly grueling and slow.

Bloodline advantages? Fierce Sun radiance? At most, these could only marginally facilitate the condensation of Fiery Sun Seeds. Even for the elite among Ancient Country royalty, surpassing the milestone of 30,000 Fiery Sun Seeds meant that condensing each additional seed demanded thousands or even tens of thousands of years.
